chinese: 没错。好的。

english: So to pick something up, to buy, to go and get, but obviously you have to pay.
chinese: 为了取、买、去拿，当然你要付钱。

english: All right. And he used this very interesting phrase when she was getting all these things for her.
chinese: 好的。他用这个非常有趣的话时，她正在为这些事情做准备。

english: She said, whoa, whoa, whoa. Are you nuts?
chinese: 她说，哎呀，哎呀，哎呀。你疯了吗？

english: Okay. So nuts is the important word here.
chinese: 好的。所以“nuts”是这里的关键词。

english: It means crazy or out of your mind.
chinese: 这意思是疯狂或者脑子进水。

english: That's right. So it's another way of saying crazy.
chinese: 没错。这其实又是在说疯狂。

english: So if you call someone nuts or you say he's nuts, that means.
chinese: 所以，如果你叫某人疯了或者你说是他疯了，那意思就是。

english: Yeah. Like, don't talk to him. He's nuts.
chinese: 是的，别跟他说话。他疯了。

english: He always says really dangerous things. He's nuts.
chinese: 他总是说很危险的话。他发疯了。

english: So he's a little bit crazy.
chinese: 他有点疯狂。

english: So it's an adjective as to describe someone that's a little bit crazy or a little bit adventurous maybe.
chinese: 所以，它形容一个人有点疯狂或者有点冒险。

english: But in this case, he's not actually saying she's a crazy person. He's saying, listen, this is so much stuff.
chinese: 但这次，他可没说她真是个疯子。他说，来，听听这些。

english: Are you crazy or he's basically saying, do you really want to do this?
chinese: 你疯了吗？他基本上是说，真的要这样做吗？

english: This seems like a bad decision.
chinese: 这看起来像是个坏决定。

english: Exactly. So that's why he used the phrase, are you nuts?
chinese: 确实。所以这就是他为什么用那个词的原因吧？

english: Okay. So a lot of great stuff there. Why don't we go back, listen to our dialogue for the last time.
chinese: 好的。所以这里有很多很棒的东西。我们为什么不回去，听听我们的对话最后一次呢？

english: And we'll be back in a bit.
chinese: 我们一会儿就回来。

english: I'm hungry. Let's go grab a bite to eat.
chinese: 我饿了。我们去吃点东西吧。

english: Yeah. Me too.
chinese: 是的。我也这样。

english: Oh, can we stop at the shop really fast?
chinese: 哎，我们真的能很快到商店吗？

english: I lost my makeup bag at the airport and I want to pick up a few things.
chinese: 我机场的化妆包丢了，想补几样东西。

english: Will you take long?
chinese: 你请假吗？

english: No. Five minutes. I promise.
chinese: 好的，五分钟。我保证。

english: Come on. We've been here for almost an hour.
chinese: 来吧，我们已经在这里快一个小时了。

english: I thought you said you're only going to get a few things.
chinese: 我以为你说你只带几个东西。

english: How long does it take you to pick out a lipstick and some nail polish?
chinese: 你挑选口红和指甲油要花多久时间？

english: Are you crazy? You have no idea what you're talking about.
chinese: 你疯了吗？你根本不知道你在说什么。

english: Just for my eyes, I have to get eyeliner, an eyelash curler, eyeshadow, an eyebrow pencil, and mascara.
chinese: 对于我的眼睛，我必须涂眼线、睫毛夹、眼影、眉笔和睫毛膏。

english: Then I need to get foundation, liquid foundation.
chinese: 然后我需要买粉底液。

english: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Are you nuts?
chinese: 哇，哇，哇。你疯了吗？

english: How much is all this going to cost?
chinese: 这整件事到底要花多少钱？

english: I'm looking at the price of each one of these little things and it's outrageous.
chinese: 我正在看这些小玩意的价格，简直离谱。

english: This is basically a crayon.
chinese: 这基本上是一支蜡笔。

english: What about you?
chinese: 你呢？

english: You spend as much money or more on your razors after shave, cologne, and tell.
chinese: 你花的钱比剃须刀、香水和告诉的多吗？

english: Not to mention how much you spend on clothes and...
chinese: 当然，你花在衣服上的钱有多少呢？

english: Fine. Get the stupid $30 crayon.
chinese: 好的。拿到那根便宜的30美元蜡笔吧。

english: Alright, so talking about makeup, a lot of things here.
chinese: 好的，所以说到化妆，这里有很多东西。

english: Maybe I didn't mention a couple of things.
chinese: 可能是我忘了提到一些事情。

english: We took a look at the most important things, I think.
chinese: 我们看看最重要的事情，我觉得。

english: You also mentioned something, for example, cover up.
chinese: 你说的那件事，比如说掩盖。

english: There's something such makeup called cover up.
chinese: 有一种叫遮瑕的化妆品。

english: Yeah, so cover up.
chinese: 真的，所以遮掩一下。

english: It could be a couple of different things in English.
chinese: 这可能是几种不同的事情。

english: For example, something that you wear to cover your body when you're at the beach.
chinese: 例如，当你去海滩时穿的遮体衣服。

english: You don't want to walk around and everyone can see you in your bathing suit.
chinese: 你不想到处走动，所有人都能看见你在游泳衣里。

english: But when we're talking about makeup, a cover up is a thing that we use to hide.
chinese: 但是当我们谈论化妆时，一个遮盖就是我们用来隐藏的东西。

english: Blumishes or zits or pimples.
chinese: 痘痘或者粉刺。

english: So you know when you get a really small red dot on your face and you're embarrassed and it's ugly.
chinese: 所以你一定知道，当你在脸蛋上长出一个非常小的红色点子，并且这个点子让你感到尴尬和丑陋的时候。

english: And you don't want anyone to see it.
chinese: 你不想让任何人看到。

english: Well, cover up is a kind of makeup you use that looks like your skin color.
chinese: 嗯，遮瑕膏是一种你用来看起来和肤色一样的化妆品。

english: And you put it on top and you can't see the red anymore.
chinese: 你把它放在最上面，再看就看不见红色了。

english: Okay, so you cover up your pimple.
chinese: 好的，你遮住你的痘痘了。

english: Yeah, or you use cover up. It's a noun too.
chinese: 是的，或者你可以用遮盖。它是名词哦。

english: Okay, and I've also seen that many girls don't really wear too much lipstick anymore nowadays.
chinese: 好的，我还发现现在很多女孩子其实并不太喜欢戴太多口红。

english: They use this thing called lip gloss.
chinese: 他们用这个叫口红的东西。

english: Okay, lip gloss.
chinese: 好的，口红。

english: Remember we were talking about polish earlier?
chinese: 记得我们之前聊过波兰的事情吗？

english: Well, gloss is a similar word.
chinese: 嗯，gloss确实是一个类似的词。

english: It means something that makes another thing shiny.
chinese: 意思是让另一样东西闪闪发光。

english: And so lipstick can be very dry, can be very flat, can be very flat.
chinese: 所以口红可能会很干涸，也可能很平坦。

english: But lip gloss is something that makes things look wet, makes things look shiny.
chinese: 但口红会让一切看起来湿润，让一切看起来光亮。

english: Okay. And actually one last thing before, when we talked about gel,
chinese: 好的。我们再提一下最后一件事，之前我们在讨论凝胶时提到的。

english: I guess guys use gel, but women use this thing called moose.
chinese: 我猜你们用凝胶，但女人这是叫啥子玩意儿啊。

english: Or they could use gel too.
chinese: 他们也可以用凝胶。

english: I don't think it's gender specific, but a lot of people use moose.
chinese: 我觉得这不完全是性别问题，但很多人用的是鹿。

english: I know some men who use moose as well.
chinese: 我知道有些男人也用鹿。

english: Moose is kind of like a foam.
chinese: Moose有点像泡沫。

english: You know, it comes in a can and it goes,
chinese: 你知道，它装在罐子里，它就去了。

english: Yeah, and it inflates this white substance.
chinese: 是的，这会膨胀这种白色的物质。

english: Yeah, it looks like, I don't know, like whipped cream.
chinese: 是的，看起来像奶油。

english: Like whipped cream, yeah.
chinese: 就像奶油一样，是的。

english: And you put it in your hair and it's very fluffy.
chinese: 你把它梳到头发里，特别蓬松。

english: And it's actually less strong.
chinese: 而且它实际上不那么坚固。

english: It's not like gel because if you put it in your hair, your hair won't look hard.
chinese: 不是像胶水一样，因为如果你把它涂到头发上，你的头发不会看起来硬。

english: But it will help shape your hair if you want to keep your hair in one place.
chinese: 但如果你想要把头发保持在一个地方，它会帮助你。

english: A lot of things here, I think in beauty and cosmetics,
chinese: 我觉得这里有很多东西，我想在美容和化妆品方面。

english: we have a lot of a lot of things.
chinese: 我们有很多很多的事情。

english: And probably we didn't even touch on half of the things that are out there.
chinese: 而且我们可能根本没有触及到那些存在的大部分事情。

chinese: 所以，如果你有任何关于这个课程的问题或想要向我们询问其他任何事情，请随时联系我们。

english: you could always come to EnglishPod.com and leave your questions and comments there.
chinese: 你可以随时来到英语pod.com，把你的问题和评论留在那儿。

chinese: 我们会在英语广播那里见，下次见。
